messages:
maria_p: Quick RFC — proposal for a 'chat compat adapter' on the server: accept both `messages` array and legacy `prompt` string, normalize server-side to a canonical `messages` model. Goal is to minimize SDK churn and accelerate customer migration while keeping function-calling and structured output intact. Looking for scope/prioritization + concrete launch criteria. :eyes:
aj: love the idea. what's the minimal surface we can ship and call it 'safe'? my vote: 1) accept `prompt` + `messages`, 2) canonicalize roles, 3) preserve function-calling/streaming behavior. everything else is follow-on.
sam_g: technical risks to flag: different models treat a top-level system message very differently. If we auto-insert a `system` from `prompt` we might change model behavior in subtle ways. Need to capture that in regression tests.
nisha_ml: from our evals, injecting system text often shifts token windows & scoring. Suggest we normalize `prompt` -> `system` but also keep the original input in traces and mark it as "injected" so evals + customers can see the transformation.
diego: ops note: we should expose a header to indicate which input shape was used so routing/costing/metrics can separate legacy vs native usage. propose `X-RW-compat: prompt|messages|hybrid`.
chloe_sre: rollout checklist suggestion: feature flag, canary in one region, E2E tests for streaming + function calls, chaos tests around partial responses. Also: ensure normalized messages appear in audit logs with a flag showing origin.
maria_p: draft launch criteria (thoughts): - SDKs accept both shapes (shim) or server-side adapter exists - server-side normalization has traceability & doesn't increase 95th latency by >10% - function-calls preserved for both shapes and work in streaming - regression evals run on representative prompt sets and pass thresholds - docs + migration guide published. Anything glaringly missing?
aj: add: rolling rollback plan + compat header as must-haves. Also define fallback role mapping for unknown roles (map to `user` by default).
nisha_ml: proposal for role mapping rules we can ship quickly: unknown -> `user`; `assistant`/`bot` -> `assistant`; `system`/`instructions` -> `system`. Ship with whitelist + telemetry so we can iterate.
sam_g: rough canonicalization snippet for server (pseudo):
```
if (payload.prompt) {
  messages = [{role: 'system', content: payload.prompt}].concat(payload.messages || []);
} else {
  messages = payload.messages;
}
// normalize roles
messages = messages.map(m => ({role: roleMap[m.role] || 'user', content: m.content}));
```
diego: ops question: caching and KV keys — can we ensure we hash normalized messages canonical form so prompt+messages and equivalent messages arrays map to same cache entry? otherwise we'll lose cache efficiency.
maria_p: suggested timeline: 6 weeks to canary, 10 weeks to GA. Prioritization (P0/P1/P2):
- P0: server adapter + role mapping rules + pass-through for function calls + trace flags
- P1: SDK shims (js/python) and migration examples + compat header metrics
- P2: server auto-linting + opt-in auto-migration flags + advanced role aliasing (customer-configurable)
chloe_sre: owners? eng/runtime = sam_g, api = aj, ml/evals = nisha_ml, docs/pm = maria_p, infra/deploy = diego. I'll create runbook checklists for canary + rollback.
maria_p: I'll write a short RFC with the above and a concrete test matrix. cc @aj @sam_g @nisha_ml. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: feature-flag `chat-compat-adapter` created (FF-4312).
